mailIdentity.description: Key the plugin uses for duplicate detection: msgid:, uid: or digest:

mailSenderName.description: Display name from the From header, absent when the sender used a bare address

mailReceivedAt.description: When the mail server received the message, as an ISO-8601 instant

mailBodyResourceId.description: Temporary resource storage id of the body; the body itself is never a process variable

mailBodyIsHtml.description: True when the body resource holds HTML rather than plain text

mailAttachmentCount.description: Number of attachments stored in temporary resource storage

replySubject.description: Subject of the mail that resumed the case at the receive task

replyReceivedAt.description: When the reply was received, as an ISO-8601 instant

replyBodyResourceId.description: Temporary resource storage id of the reply body

reviewOutcome.description: What the handler decided on the review-mail user task; written by the review-mail form
